full_prompt_en: A square, thickly painted abstract landscape shows a pale round moon above stacked blocks of yellow, orange, green and black. The upper third is a broad deep cobalt-blue sky scratched with visible horizontal brush marks. Near the upper center-right, a cream-pink moon sits as a simple flat disc without modeled craters. Beneath it, a wide strip of dusty rose and lavender crosses the frame and forms the horizonlike middle band. A jagged cluster of ochre-yellow peaks or rooflike shapes rises from the center-left into that pink area. Below the pointed forms, squat rectangular pieces in mustard, orange, dark green and charcoal pile toward the lower center. A bright yellow rectangle stands on the right side of the cluster, with a teal-blue shape immediately below. The lower portion is broken into wide horizontal bars of coral pink, turquoise, purple, brown and a little cream, suggesting ground or reflection without resolving into a literal scene. Broad opaque brushstrokes leave ridges and scraped gaps where one color presses against another. The edges of the blocks are blunt and imperfect, neither mechanically straight nor delicately blended. Light is graphic and distributed by the high-value moon, yellow and pink fields; there is no natural cast shadow. The deep blue sky and black accents give the warm central stack weight, while the lighter lower bars spread the color across the page. The overall composition feels calm and luminous despite its assertive pigment, balancing one simple circle with a dense uneven tower of color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、厚涂的抽象风景里，一轮浅色圆月悬在黄、橙、绿与黑的叠块上方。上方三分之一是宽阔深钴蓝天空，可见横向刮擦笔痕。上方中心偏右，一轮奶油粉色月亮如简单平涂圆盘，没有塑形的环形坑纹。其下，一道灰玫瑰色与淡紫色宽带横穿画幅，形成近似地平线的中段。中心偏左，一簇锯齿状赭黄尖峰或屋顶状形体升入粉色区域。尖形下方，芥黄、橙、深绿和炭色的低矮矩形块堆向下方中央。叠块右侧立着一个亮黄长方形，下方紧挨青蓝色形。下部被珊瑚粉、青绿、紫、褐和少量奶油色的宽横条打散，暗示地面或倒影，却没有成为写实场景。宽阔不透明笔触留下凸脊和刮开的缝，一种颜色紧压另一种。色块边缘钝而不齐，既非机械直线，也未细腻融合。光图形化，由高明度月亮、黄色和粉色色域分配，没有自然投影。深蓝天空与黑色强调让暖色中央叠块有重量，较浅下方横带把色彩铺开。整体构图虽颜料强烈却平静发亮，让一枚简洁圆形与密集不齐的色塔相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The painted surface uses broad opaque slabs of color with thick ridges, visible drag marks and blunt irregular joins. Deep cobalt, dusty pink, bright yellow, turquoise, orange and black meet in clear warm-cool blocks rather than smooth gradients. A single small pale disc or high-value patch steadies the upper field, while stacked rectangular forms and low horizontal bands create rhythm below. Light is inherent in color contrast; modeling and cast shadow remain minimal. The handmade texture keeps the flat shapes alive and slightly uneven. The result is compact, luminous and boldly simplified, with color relationships carrying more weight than literal depth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画表面使用宽阔不透明色板，带厚凸脊、可见拖笔和钝而不齐的接缝。深钴蓝、灰粉、亮黄、青绿、橙和黑以清楚冷暖色块相遇，而非平滑渐层。一小块上方浅色圆形或高明度区域稳住上部，下方叠起的矩形与低位横带建立节奏。亮光内生于色彩对照；塑形与投影极少。手工肌理让平面形状活着且略不均匀。成品紧凑、发亮并大胆概括，色彩关系比字面纵深更有分量。
theme_en: A pale moon over stacked bright shapes and pink horizontal bands
theme_zh: 浅色圆月悬在亮色叠块和粉色横带之上
name: Etel Adnan
